Let the opposite edges be \(AB\) and \(CD\). Unfold the two adjacent faces \(ABC\) and \(BCD\) along edge \(BC\).

In the plane take
\[
B=(0,0),\quad C=(1,0),\quad A=\left(\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right),\quad D=\left(\frac12,-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right).
\]
Then
\[
M_1=\text{midpoint of }AB=\left(\frac14,\frac{\sqrt3}{4}\right),
\]
\[
M_2=\text{midpoint of }CD=\left(\frac34,-\frac{\sqrt3}{4}\right).
\]
The straight-line distance is
\[
\sqrt{\left(\frac34-\frac14\right)^2+\left(-\frac{\sqrt3}{4}-\frac{\sqrt3}{4}\right)^2}
=
\sqrt{\left(\frac12\right)^2+\left(-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)^2}
=
\sqrt{\frac14+\frac34}=1.
\]
This straight segment crosses the shared edge \(BC\), so it gives a valid surface path.

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
